description: As eu07_td_crew_add, with a Traxx (E186, p160dc) standing ready to depart (trainset velocity 0.1) with nobody in it: its brake handle, one with a time chamber (MHZ_6P), in the holding position and the brake pipe and the control reservoir at running pressure. The AI driver put in cab A 20 s after the start gets the locomotive ready, puts the handle to running and leaves through the exit signal.

trainsets: node -1 0 {{vehicle}} dynamic pkp/e186_v2 146_226-6 p160dc 0 nobody 0 0 enddynamic
crew: event autotest_crew_put putvalues 0 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}} 1 0 endevent
event autotest_crew_on multiple 20 none autotest_crew_put autotest_crew_waits endevent
node -1 0 autotest_crew_on_launcher eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1034 autotest_crew_on end

checks.pattern: Crew: \[autotest_traxx_td_crew_add\] an AI driver takes cab A
